description: Functional specifications/files: audit SDK post/send/edit option propagation, adapter capability extensions, raw receipt/report normalization; owners existing JidoChatBridge and Mattermost Adapter. Tests to add before implementation: wrapper-level create/edit policy propagation and coherent extension capability checks in sibling tests. Branches: explicit policy vs absent option; unsupported strict before any I/O. Mocking: injected edge transport only. Documentation: adapter public contract and Channels guide at final step. Action reuse assessment: extend existing Thread.post/Adapter callbacks and capability map; metadata.delivery_report preserved by Response; no new lifecycle/API/Action/tool. Contract inputs provider-neutral attachment_failure_policy :continue/:abort, existing results/errors; preserve authorization/threading and absent-option behavior. Consumers code-only existing delivery, no agent exposure. SDK sources inspected live; no third-repo changes required.
title: [zaq-ucc] Verify existing policy option and capability contracts
